notes: Maps OSHB morphology codes (pinned corpus in corpus-pin.json) to the earliest BBH lesson whose material covers that grammatical feature, or marks them unmapped.

Entry shape: {"morphPattern": "<OSHB code or prefix>", "bbhLesson": N | null, "unmapped": true?, "note": "..."}. A token whose morphology is unmapped or future-lesson can never enter Strict or Guided decks.
Populated in Phase 2 PR D alongside tools/import_oshb_reader.mjs. Empty in PR A by design.
